name: Luna-13 ALS
about: Luna-13 ALS (1966-116A, NII88), launched 1966 Dec 21. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
